coaching.headline: Steady strides, keep the heart happy 😊
coaching.coaching: Today's 6 km at 7:49/km kept your average HR at 148 bpm, well under the MAF ceiling of 155 bpm, so you stayed in true Z2 aerobic zone. The max HR of 160 bpm was a brief spike—keep an eye on it—but your cadence of 176 spm and power of 185 W show solid form.
coaching.trend: Your recent runs show consistent HR control (147‑154 bpm) while pacing hovers around the 7:40‑8:24/km range, indicating good aerobic stability. Training load remains light, which is fine for base building, but you’ll need a gradual increase to reach 20 km comfortably.
coaching.nextRun: Run 8 km at a target pace of 8:00‑8:10 per km, keep HR no higher than 154 bpm, and focus on maintaining a cadence around 175 spm while lowering ground contact time toward 260 ms.
